nodes.name: dirichlet_constant_one_table_value
nodes.summary: Every actual positive in-domain lookup in a constant-one table is canonical signed one, independently of its zero entry.

nodes.name: dirichlet_kronecker_delta_table_one_value
nodes.summary: The actual entry at index one is signed one whenever that index lies in the finite table domain.

nodes.name: dirichlet_kronecker_delta_table_other_value
nodes.summary: Every other positive in-domain delta entry is canonical zero; the omitted index-zero case remains unrestricted.

nodes.name: dirichlet_kronecker_delta_value_exists
nodes.summary: Constructively decide whether an index is one, obtaining its actual zero-or-one signed value before extending any table.

nodes.name: dirichlet_constant_one_table_append
nodes.summary: Actually append signed one at the next positive index by paired beta recoding, preserving the full previous prefix including zero.

nodes.name: dirichlet_kronecker_delta_table_append
nodes.summary: Append the separately chosen actual delta value, preserving every earlier signed entry rather than assuming a table oracle.

nodes.name: dirichlet_constant_one_table_exists
nodes.summary: For every finite bound, construct a genuine constant-one table retaining any prescribed signed value at zero, including the empty positive domain.

nodes.name: dirichlet_kronecker_delta_table_exists
nodes.summary: Finite constructive equality decisions and actual beta extensions build the delta table for every N, preserving any zero entry.

nodes.name: dirichlet_constant_one_table_reencoding
nodes.summary: Equal represented positive values preserve this table graph without equating table codes, component representatives or their arbitrary zero entries.

nodes.name: dirichlet_constant_one_table_positive_unique
nodes.summary: All constructed representations agree at every positive in-domain entry; neither equality at zero nor equality of arbitrary table encodings is asserted.

nodes.name: dirichlet_kronecker_delta_table_reencoding
nodes.summary: Equal represented positive values preserve this table graph without equating table codes, component representatives or their arbitrary zero entries.

nodes.name: dirichlet_kronecker_delta_table_positive_unique
nodes.summary: All constructed representations agree at every positive in-domain entry; neither equality at zero nor equality of arbitrary table encodings is asserted.

nodes.name: dirichlet_delta_right_entry_before_input
nodes.summary: Every actual summand before n vanishes: a real complementary quotient is positive and cannot be one, while omitted indices are already zero.

nodes.name: dirichlet_delta_right_last_entry
nodes.summary: At the final divisor n, actually read delta(1), use the quotient n=n*1, and multiply F(n) by signed one.

nodes.name: dirichlet_delta_right_sum_value
nodes.summary: The actual zero-prefix/last-entry fold proves (F*delta)(n)=F(n), with positivity supplied by the convolution itself.

nodes.name: dirichlet_delta_right_sum
nodes.summary: Construct a genuine convolution fold and prove its value equals the given actual F(n), rather than postulating the desired unit identity.

nodes.name: dirichlet_delta_right_table
nodes.summary: The original represented table F is a genuine whole-table right-unit convolution output on every positive input through N.

nodes.name: dirichlet_delta_left_table
nodes.summary: Actual divisor-complement commutativity turns the proved right-unit table into the left-unit table without imposing a zero-entry condition.

nodes.name: dirichlet_delta_unit_exists
nodes.summary: Every actual finite signed arithmetic table has a constructed two-sided convolution unit, with any requested unrelated value at index zero.

nodes.name: dirichlet_constant_one_entry_to_divisor_mask
nodes.summary: At every actual positive divisor the complementary one-table factor is signed one, so the convolution entry is precisely the existing divisor-mask entry.

nodes.name: dirichlet_constant_one_entry_from_divisor_mask
nodes.summary: Construct the actual bounded complementary lookup and its signed product from a genuine divisor-mask entry; omitted zero/nondivisor entries stay zero.

nodes.name: dirichlet_constant_one_prefix_to_divisor_mask
nodes.summary: The same actual signed prefix represents the weighted convolution mask and the existing divisor mask; this preserves all witnesses and arbitrary prefix lengths.

nodes.name: dirichlet_constant_one_prefix_from_divisor_mask
nodes.summary: The same actual signed prefix represents the weighted convolution mask and the existing divisor mask; this preserves all witnesses and arbitrary prefix lengths.

nodes.name: dirichlet_constant_one_sum_iff
nodes.summary: Actual convolution with a constant-one table is equivalent to the independently defined signed divisor sum, with exactly the same constructed mask and fold.

nodes.name: dirichlet_constant_one_realizes_divisor_sum
nodes.summary: Construct an actual constant-one table with any chosen zero entry, and prove simultaneously at every positive in-domain input that its convolution is the existing divisor transform.

nodes.name: Le
nodes.summary: Witness-defined non-strict order on natural numbers.

nodes.name: Lt
nodes.summary: Witness-defined strict order on natural numbers.

nodes.name: MatrixMinorFourCode
nodes.summary: One canonical injective doubled-Cantor code for all four signed-minor beta-code parameters.

nodes.name: BetaAt
nodes.summary: x is the bounded beta-decoded value at index i.

nodes.name: SignedDecode
nodes.summary: The original canonical integer code: even 2p denotes p, and odd 2k+1 denotes −(k+1). The decoded positive and negative parts are normalized.

nodes.name: SignedBalance
nodes.summary: The original canonical code z represents the integer difference p−n; these supplied components need not be normalized.

nodes.name: ArithAt
nodes.summary: Two genuine beta entries of the packed table represent the unique canonical signed value z. Distinct component representations need not be equal.

nodes.name: Dvd
nodes.summary: The natural number d divides n.

nodes.name: SignedMul
nodes.summary: Actual multiplication of original canonical signed codes; opposite-sign products remain on the negative side of the balance.

nodes.name: DirichletEntry
nodes.summary: At a positive divisor d, witness n=d*q, read the actual signed values F(d) and G(q), and multiply them. Zero and nondivisors contribute canonical zero without reading either input at zero. Source-table validity is separate.

nodes.name: ArithTable
nodes.summary: An actual packed signed table with canonical signed entries through index N, including index zero. It contains no divisor transform or inversion hypothesis.

nodes.name: DirichletPrefix
nodes.summary: An actual signed table M records the independently defined convolution entry at every inclusive index 0<=d<=l. The endpoint l is included and can differ from n; no sum or convolution identity is assumed.

nodes.name: Sum
nodes.summary: z is the sum of a beta-coded prefix of length l.

nodes.name: SignedPrefixSum
nodes.summary: The signed balance of two actual natural finite sums, at exactly the indices 0<=i<l. Existence, uniqueness and representation independence are proved separately.

nodes.name: DirichletSum
nodes.summary: Require n>0, construct a real convolution-summand prefix through n, and take its actual signed fold over exactly S n entries. Zero is outside this sum's input domain; no value is assigned by a unit or inversion formula.

nodes.name: DirichletTable
nodes.summary: Three actual finite signed tables whose output H(n), at every 0<n<=N, is the independently defined convolution sum of F and G. All zero entries are unrestricted; only represented positive values, not table codes, are subsequently proved unique.

nodes.name: DivisorMaskEntry
nodes.summary: A positive d with an actual quotient n=d*q keeps the genuine input value F(d); zero and nondivisors give canonical zero. The zero branch never reads or restricts F(0).

nodes.name: DivisorMask
nodes.summary: An actual signed table through the inclusive bound l satisfies the independent divisor-mask entry graph at every represented index. The construction bound l is independent of n, enabling ordinary finite induction.

nodes.name: DivisorSum
nodes.summary: For explicitly positive n, construct a genuine mask through n and take its actual signed fold over S n entries. Index zero is masked away; neither divisor cancellation nor Möbius inversion is part of the graph.

nodes.name: ArithPositiveEqual
nodes.summary: Equality of represented values at precisely 0<d<=N. Values at zero are unrestricted, and raw codes or positive/negative representatives are not asserted equal.

nodes.name: SignedZeroWindow
nodes.summary: Every actual signed lookup on the half-open interval k<=i<l has value zero. Table validity, existence of folds, and equality after padding are separate hypotheses or theorems, not part of this graph.

nodes.name: ConstantOneTable
nodes.summary: An actual signed table has canonical one, code 2, at every 0<n<=N. Its value at zero is unrestricted, including when N=0. Existence with any prescribed zero entry and the divisor-sum identity are separately proved.

nodes.name: KroneckerDeltaTable
nodes.summary: An actual signed table has code 2 at n=1 and code 0 at all other positive n<=N. Its zero entry is unrestricted and N=0 has an empty positive domain. Both convolution unit laws are theorems, not definition premises.
